title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Your assistant is on step 4 of answering one student's request. Which statement about what the model knows at that step is correct?

options.text: It knows what the program sent in this call's input
It retains hidden state from steps 1 through 3 itself
It can read the booking system whenever it chooses
It recalls this student from visits in earlier weeks

items.stem: The instructions, tool descriptions and question total 1,000 tokens. The model is called 3 times, and each of the first two calls ends with a tool result of 500 tokens that is added to the context. Ignoring the model's own output tokens, how many input tokens are sent across all 3 calls in total?
A student finishes laser cutter training today and returns next week in a new session. Which design lets the assistant know this next week?

options.text: A larger context window on the model being used
A note saved to a file, then loaded at session start
A longer system prompt with detailed behavior rules
A step limit on the number of loop iterations

items.stem: In one sentence, why does retrieving only the relevant manual chunks usually cost less per request than putting a whole manual in the context?
A long task is about to exceed the context window. Name one technique the program can use to continue the task without losing its key facts.
